Announcements
Aug 20, 2025, 12:55 UTC
CloudTalk is SOC 2 Type II Compliant
We’re proud to announce that CloudTalk has successfully completed a SOC 2 Type II audit, conducted by independent auditors.
This achievement highlights our ongoing commitment to protecting customer data and upholding the highest standards of information security. By meeting the rigorous SOC 2 Type II requirements, we provide our customers and partners with the assurance that CloudTalk’s systems and processes are built on a strong foundation of trust and reliability.
You can access the full report and details directly in our Trust Portal.
Mar 7, 2025, 13:55 UTC
We have launched our trust center 
We are happy to announce the launch of our Trust Center — your one-stop destination for all security and privacy documentation.
We understand that the safety of your information is of utmost importance. That’s why we’ve brought together comprehensive resources to help you stay informed and confident about our security practices.
Explore our Trust Center to learn more about our data protection measures, compliance certifications, and our ongoing efforts to maintain a secure environment for your communications.
